lines: — DAY 118 DAWN — The world wakes. Animals are active.
Overnight, Muscadine Grapes went bad — beyond saving. You leave it for the flies.
Fresh food keeps days, not weeks. Smoke it over a fire to make it last.
🎁 You find a small bundle tucked where you'll find it. No one saw it left there.
"They're sending Vex after you tomorrow. He's bored. Be somewhere else."
(201 kcal of dried meat and clean water. Nothing traceable.)
💬 Olivia says: "If they're watching, let them watch me work. That's all I've got."
💬 Ruby says: "Dreamed again. They showed me teeth. Lots of teeth. Be ready to fight soon."
The night sky holds a little longer over the village. Liam is watching, and is pleased.
Snow by morning. (-7°C — Freezing) The ground goes iron — forage thin, walking dear.
The cold works on everyone — the village wakes aching from the deep cold.
Dawn. You wake rested. (+0 health, energy restored. By the fire. Good enough.)
No risky water to boil.
Drank clean water.
📋 Génesis — 💧 Fetch water. Génesis nods eagerly. They'll report back by next part.
Ruby watches you give the order. "Interesting. Nobody asked me."
Ruby waits until the fire's lit and people are watching. Then, loud enough for all of them: "Who put YOU in charge?"

◈ THE TABLE — it is not a table. It's a ring of pale light, and around it, things with too many angles to be faces. Above it all — the audience. Trillions of eyes, and every one of them knows your name. The System speaks, and for once it isn't performing: "HUMANITY PRESENTS ITS CASE."

◈ THE AUDIT — the System reads your run back to you, and the galaxy listens. A lesser seat — global standing, waves 1–3 faced (17/6/3), 15 contests survived, 2 crises weathered. The table does not rise. It prices.
The table notes 1 ascension from one village — its terms improve accordingly. Nobody has ever seen that before.
EVERYONE. SIT. WATCH. The teeth and the weather can WAIT — nothing out there matters until this is done. ...Did I stutter? SIT.
💧 Ruby returns with 14L of creek water. Risky until the hearth boils it.

🌿 Ruby checks the pantry before heading out — the shelves are full, ~24 days of fresh on hand… leaves the fish nets standing and turns to the water run instead. The pantry can't take more; the wild will keep.
💧 Ruby returns with 14L, but the cistern only holds 3L more.

🪨 Ruby pries 1 stone loose from the creek bed. The building pile grows. (469 stone now.)

🍲 Ruby cooked for the haven — meals stretched. The racks are already full (45,153 kcal kept — more than the haven can eat before it turns), so Ruby left the fresh pile for tonight's dinner instead of smoking it onto the rot pile.
💧 Génesis returns with 17L, but the cistern only holds 0L more.
You catch fragments by the fire — Génesis telling Olivia about you. The story's getting bigger than what happened.
🚶 Ruby is back — found Tashi.
◈ THE SYSTEM has been watching Desmond — Field 1. Three offers; they took Echo Location. Earned, chosen. (echo_location: villager level-up)

📖 Olivia is re-packing the bundle, checking each thing twice before it goes back in.
📖 Sigrun has their finds spread out on a cloth, re-tying the bundle tighter.
Iron cold. Even the ticks are shelved.
— MIDDAY — Honest work hours. Heat builds.
You wait. The light changes. Nothing asks anything of you.

— NIGHT — Camp. Rest — or risk the dark.
No watches tonight. Everyone sleeps with one ear open and pretends not to.
You wait. The light changes. Nothing asks anything of you.
◈ ABILITY — Spotlight: The room is already warm. Audience starts at 2.
◈ ABILITY — Callback: One bad act can be redone. (Offered once, after a bad beat.)
◈ ABILITY — Standing-O: Genuine love doesn't crater: the audience can't fall below 0 while you hold it.
◈ ABILITY — Eulogy: The quiet ones' act lands harder than any headliner. (Offered in the final beat.)
🔴 LIVE! the variety finale: ONE NIGHT ONLY

◈ THE BELOVED — The audience is chanting. You don't know the words — it isn't a language with words — but you know the feeling. The table can't move against the cast's favorite. That's leverage. Tonight, the cast is your village.
The table has read your ledger. The protected outnumber the killed; the food truth was shared. The light road is open.
Desmond tells the hunt — the real one, with the fear left in. The audience goes silent in the good way. Silence, at this scale, is deafening.
The feast song — the one about eating like it matters, because it does. Trillions of beings who never ate anything hear it and feel hungry for the first time. The ratings spike is audible.

You spend it all — the love, the light, the finale slot — on people the cameras never found. You name the unfilmed villages. You name the dead. The audience weeps in eleven dimensions. This is what the show was for, it turns out.
◈ THE BELOVED — the last choice is yours, and it's live.
◈ THE BELOVED — "Let the audience speak."

The show becomes the government. Strange. It works. Trillions of viewers hold the table to account in real time, and humanity's seat is wherever the cameras are. You made popularity into a constitution — and constitutions, unlike ratings, don't dip.

◈ OUTSHONE — Ruby Callaghan did what you would not: acted, boldly, while there was still time. The village thrives. The god is someone else. The record notes, kindly and accurately, that you watched. It stings exactly as much as it should.
The terms held — the table had priced the village, ascension and all, and the village paid in full.
◈ THE OVERSIGHT —
You won. Say it plainly: you won. The village endures. The table signed. The galaxy applauds, and the applause is real, and you earned it.
And somewhere out there — past the cameras, past the light — in rows of humming glass, the little ones are still napping.
The System put a pod on the screen, and you let the segment play.
They are still there. Still small. Still waiting for someone to decide they matter more than the moment.

That is what the word means. Not the watching — anyone can watch. The oversight is the looking away. The most terrible thing the System ever did, it did by accident, because it was bored. You did it on purpose, because you were busy.
The village will tell your story for years. It will be a good story. Listen for the part they don't tell.

💛 You hold Tote Bag. Your gifts are not mastered — but they are lived-in, worn smooth by use, and they are with you. The feast was the weapon. (The next feast grants FEASTED until tomorrow's dawn: strikes & abilities uplifted, devotion ×1.5 — richer feasts hit harder.)
📋 Génesis — 🎣 Fish. Génesis nods eagerly. They'll report back by next part.
📋 Liam — 🍲 Cook. Liam nods eagerly. They'll report back by next part.
Ruby folds their arms. "Sure. Your call. For now."
